manifest.name: dsh-plugin-message-model-badge
manifest.description: Show which provider and model produced a reply, in the message's own action row.
manifest.author: Jiaxin Kou <https://hypersampling.com>

bundle.text:
# dsh-plugin-message-model-badge — bundle layer.
#
# One row mounts the package. It is dual-face: the Host half registers the
# `messageModel` session projection (the fold over `assistant/message`), and the
# `dsh.client` declaration makes the harness serve the browser half that renders
# the projected label in the assistant message's action row.
- insert:
    - id: message-model-badge
      name: 'dsh-plugin-message-model-badge'

readme.text: See which **provider and model produced a reply** — `deepseek-official/deepseek-flash`, `bailian/qwen3.5-27b` — in the message's own action row. It matters once a Session talks to more than one model, and in subagent Sessions, which run on their own model.

> 消息旁显示产出它的 provider/model
中文说明（点开） 消息的操作行里（复制、👍👎 那一排）多出一段次要文字，写明这条回复是哪个 provider 的哪个 model 产出的。主会话和子代理会话都有效——子代理跑在自己的会话里，用它自己的模型。 两点需要知道： - **一个回合只显示一处**：DSH 只在回合收尾的那条助手消息上渲染操作行，所以一个回合里的多条助手消息只有最后一条被标注。 - **只标不猜**：多模型会话里，早于最近 300 条的消息不显示标识，而不是标成最新的模型；单模型会话不受影响，全部正确。 这是个**纯界面插件**：Host 侧只注册一个 session projection，把日志里本来就有的 `message.source` 递给浏览器，不写文件、不加事件类型、不改任何其他插件的数据。客户端不自己折叠会话事件——这是 DSH 的规矩。

```text
github:kjx-talesofai/dsh-plugin-message-model-badge#v0.1.1
```

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:kjx-talesofai/dsh-plugin-message-model-badge#v0.1.1
```

Then **restart the desktop app**. A local checkout works too, with an absolute path. Upgrading is uninstall-then-install.

Requires **DSH Desktop ≥ 0.2.0-rc.1 and < 0.3.0**.

The suite drives the projection fold directly and the browser half through the loader shape it ships in. It does **not** cover the harness end — that the projection arrives in a real browser, or how the label looks in the row. That was confirmed by hand on **macOS (Apple Silicon) · DSH Desktop 0.2.0-rc.2**: `bailian/qwen3.5-27b` in a subagent Session, `deepseek-official/deepseek-flash` in a normal one. On 0.2.1-rc.2 the action-row seat is still taken by the badge.
